title: Different Currencies in Payout Settings
body:
Being paid is important! You & the team has been working tirelessly on your adventure & deserve to not be inconvenienced when it comes to what currency you're able to collect your earnings in. The option to change currencies is little hidden so here we'll go over how to make that adjustment. 

Payout Settings

You'll want to first head into the Payout Settings page. Navigate to the developer portal & look for Teams > Settings > Payout Settings > Edit Payout Info.

The first form for Address will be your standard details for bank records. Depending on the region that you've entered in this screen will determine what appears on the following Payment Method screen. 

Note the change in Payment Currency when I use the Louvre Museum in Paris; 

Compared to my childhood home (United States); 

The Payment Currency options are tied to the address provided. If no payment currency option shows up this means the option will be set to the default - USD.

Payout via PayPal

When selecting PayPal for the Payment Method you'll notice you're able to select what Payment Currency you want despite what information you put in the previous Address form.
